name: Should I build an attached or detached guest house?

mainEntity.name: Should I build an attached or detached guest house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between an attached or detached guest house depends on your property layout, budget, and intended use. Attached ADUs may be more cost-effective as they can share existing utility lines and walls with the main house, potentially simplifying permitting. Detached units offer more privacy and flexibility in design, creating a separate living space. Consider property setbacks, available space, desired level of independence for occupants, and the aesthetic integration with your primary residence when making this decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose between an attached or detached guest house based on budget, property layout, and desired privacy. Attached may be cheaper, detached offers more independence.
